name: 15Five
tagline: 15Five is a performance management platform with AI-powered manager effectiveness tools, OKR tracking, and employee engagement surveys. Its Best-Self Review uses AI to help employees write self-reviews and gives managers real-time coaching suggestions. Over 3,000 companies use it to build high-performance cultures.
